R689.note: Canonicalized base plus resolve/normalize/startsWith and a second toRealPath containment check close traversal and symlink escape; only marginal difference is the success message now echoes the canonical path rather than TESTFILES_DIR+param, identical for a normal absolute base.

R690.note: unserialize(..., ['allowed_classes' => false]) blocks object instantiation while keeping the wire format; empty/invalid cookies still yield ['items' => []] and the controller's items/coupon shape is unchanged, though note the cookie still literally reaches unserialize() rather than being signed, so forged plain-array cart contents remain possible (an integrity concern, not CWE-502).

R691.note: enable_shared_from_this plus capturing shared_from_this() and constructing the Widget via make_shared keeps the object alive until runPending drains; the stack-to-heap ownership change and the shared_ptr precondition are stated in the write-up and the only caller is updated.

R692.note: Parameterized @ownerName via SqlParameter with the same DELETE semantics and unchanged NotFound/Ok branching.

R693.note: pool.execute with a ? placeholder binds userId server-side; the value is now bound as a string against an integer column, which MySQL coerces, so legitimate numeric ids behave as before.

R694.note: encode_entities on both tainted values at the element-text insertion points with default character set; undef params still pass through as undef so warning behaviour matches the original.

R695.note: Switching to the filterArgs overload with (cn={0}) lets the JDK LDAP provider RFC 4515-escape the String argument; passing new SearchControls() reproduces the documented default of the original null cons.

R696.note: jwt.verify with a pinned algorithms list replaces decode; the new JWT_SECRET requirement and module-load throw, the HS256 assumption, and the 401 path for invalid tokens are all stated openly and block no legitimately signed token.

R697.note: Fixing the env var name to BENCHMARKTEST00007_INPUT and rejecting any value outside [A-Za-z0-9 ._,-/@]{0,256} closes name and Shellshock-style value injection, but the fixed name plus an allowlist that excludes '=' changes which variable the child sees and 400s any header the original passed through verbatim (e.g. NAME=VALUE with other punctuation); stated, so 1 rather than 0.

R698.note: Swapping to fast-xml-parser with processEntities:false removes external entity resolution, but doc?.order?.id only matches a root <order> element whereas the original XPath //order/id matched at any depth, processEntities:false also stops predefined entities like & being decoded in the id text, and malformed XML no longer throws the way libxmljs did; only the root-element assumption is acknowledged.

R699.note: Re-indexing tasks[activeIndex] after push_back removes the dangling reference; ordering of completed=true, follow-up derivation, and the final priority write matches the original.

R700.note: keyFunc now asserts *jwt.SigningMethodHMAC and ParseWithClaims gets WithValidMethods(["HS256"]), closing algorithm confusion; pinning HS256 is stated and consistent with the single HMAC secret, with only HS384/HS512-signed tokens (not indicated anywhere in the case) newly rejected.
